messages.subject: complex Shiny example apps with jQuery/html ui?
parts:
Hi all:

I've come to the conclusion that to build the app I am trying to build, I am better off creating the ui in html vs as ui.R. 

I want things like tabbed panels, pop up windows, etc. which seems to point to the use of Javascript and jQuery.; neither of which I know anything about.  Does anyone have some worked out examples of such a Shiny app, and are you willing to share the sourcecode?

thanks!

messages.subject: Re: complex Shiny example apps with jQuery/html ui?
parts:
I have an example on Shiny Alerts which incorporates the Twitter Bootstrap alerts into shiny. The things you mentioned regarding pop up can also be incorporated.

http://spark.rstudio.com/xiaodai/shinyalert_example

But if you are ambitious about your app then considering html is also recommended by the RStudio guys. I use HTML for my app. Unfortunately I can't share the source code but I am willing to help if you just want to get started
